answer: SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID JOIN products AS p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT y.CustomerID) FROM yearmonth AS y JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' AND y.Consumption > 1000

WITH t AS (SELECT c.Segment AS seg, y.CustomerID AS cid, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total FROM customers AS c JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID), m AS (SELECT seg, SUM(total) / COUNT(*) AS avg_min FROM (SELECT seg, cid, total, MIN(total) OVER (PARTITION BY seg) AS mn FROM t) WHERE total = mn GROUP BY seg) SELECT (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM, (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM, (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_min FROM m WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_SME
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
SELECT DISTINCT g.Country FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN yearmonth AS y ON t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE y.Date = '201306'
